title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Claims Desk Guidelines: Problems Found After Delivery
content:
Problems found after a completed Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment are taken as claims. Member services records the claim as submitted, the member confirms it, and the delivery claims desk approves or denies it.

## Reporting windows

All windows are counted in calendar days from the appointment's completion date, the completion date being day 0.

- **Visible merchandise damage.** Merchandise damage seen at delivery is claimed only when it is reported no later than the service level's visible-damage window after the completion date. A report on the last day of the window is within it.
- **Damage found on unpacking.** Damage found on unpacking packaged merchandise may be reported until the service level's concealed-damage window.
- **Damage to the home.** Damage to the home may be reported until the service level's property-damage window.
- **Faulty installation.** A faulty installation may be reported until the end of the service level's installation workmanship warranty.

## How each claim is settled

| Claim | Settlement |
|---|---|
| Merchandise damaged, claim approved by the claims desk | The appointment's base delivery charge is credited in full as a damage settlement entry; the damaged merchandise itself is replaced or refunded under the purchase's return rules |
| Installation defect within the workmanship warranty | Corrected on a free revisit appointment at the same service level |
| Paid add-on the crew did not perform (haul-away, stairs, parts kit or wall mount) | Credited as service not performed |
| Damage to the home | Settled by the claims desk with the crew's contractor; member services never credits or pays it |
| Missing items | Handled under the purchase's returnless refund rules |

The damage settlement credit follows an approved claim: the claim's status on the claim record must be approved.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical visible-damage window of 2 days)

| Completion date | Report date | Day count | Within the window |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5th | 7th | Day 2 | Yes |
| 5th | 8th | Day 3 | No |
| 5th | 5th | Day 0 | Yes |
